blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ke foran baad 24.3.1 shuru karti hai. Amines ke reactions nitrogen atom ke lone pair (electrons ka akela joda) ki wajah se hote hain; isi lone pair se amines base aur nucleophile ka kaam karti hain. Is hisse mein: amines ki basicity (24.3.1), nitrous acid se primary, secondary aur tertiary amines ki pehchan (24.3.2), aur phenylamine ke reactions (24.3.3).

blocks.prompt: Amine molecule ki kaun si cheez us ki basicity aur nucleophile hone, dono ki wajah hai?
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen atom par electrons ka lone pair.

items: Nitrogen ka lone pair amines ko base aur nucleophile banata hai.
